# JSON for Modern C++

Unmodified single-header dependency from the official stable **v3.12.0** release
(2025-04-11), pinned to commit
[`55f93686c01528224f448c19128836e7df245f72`](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/55f93686c01528224f448c19128836e7df245f72).
The official annotated tag resolves through tag object
`65ee68451d8eb2b5f3a30b410476ab83deb3289b` to that commit.

Imported on 2026-11-12 from the official repository:

- [`single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/55f93686c01528224f448c19128836e7df245f72/single_include/nlohmann/json.hpp)
- [`LICENSE.MIT`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nlohmann/json/55f93686c01528224f448c19128836e7df245f72/LICENSE.MIT)

The header SHA-256 matches the checksum published in the
[official release](https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/tag/v3.12.0).
[SHA256SUMS.txt](SHA256SUMS.txt) records both imported files. License: MIT;
retain [LICENSE.MIT](LICENSE.MIT) with redistributed copies.

No download occurs during configuration/build. This local manifest is independent
of the existing ImGui/ImPlot manifest; those dependencies were not changed.
The dependency pin does not itself establish Vista/7 runtime qualification.
